commitMessage: Add gameplay screenshot to top of README

topics.title: Add real gameplay screenshot to top of README
topics.trigger: The user asked to add a picture to the top of the README to give visitors a visual preview of the game.
topics.response:
- Investigated the existing repo images and found no real gameplay screenshot existed, only framework logos and documentation assets.
- Used the project's existing browser-automation test harness to spin up the game and capture several candidate images: a menu/hero screen, a populated bot-driven gameplay board, and an "Iron Snake" irregular-board variant, via a temporary capture script.
- Selected the strongest candidate (a long snake with a score of 13, visible head/eyes, food, full isometric board, and HUD), saved it as `docs/screenshot.png`, removed the temporary capture script, and added an image tag with descriptive alt text to the top of `README.md`.
topics.decisions: A real, generated gameplay screenshot was created instead of using a placeholder or stock image, since capturing an authentic in-game state gives visitors an accurate preview of what the game actually looks like. Among several candidate shots (menu screen, short bot run, longer bot run, irregular-board mode), the longer gameplay shot was chosen over the others because a longer snake with a visible score, head, and food more clearly showcased the game's isometric visual style than the flatter-angle or shorter-snake alternatives.
